items.name: Hourly pickup demand forecast per zip
items.statement: Set next hours' expected pickups per zip so supply is placed ahead of demand. Cars placed where the demand is next hour earn more per shift.

items.name: Drivers per zone and hour
items.statement: Set the number of drivers per zone and hour to meet the pickup wait target. Too few drivers lose rides; too many lose driver income.

items.name: Fares that break their expected range
items.statement: Review the trips whose fare is far from what distance and duration predict. Mis-metered fares cost revenue or customer trust.

items.name: Fare and trips by zip and the hot areas
items.statement: Name the zip areas that stand out on trips and fare per mile for the zone plan. Zone plans built on the map put cars where trips pay.

items.name: Pickup to drop-off flows between zones
items.statement: Find the hub zones most trips pass through and plan cover when they jam. A jam at a hub zone delays trips across the network.

items.name: Fare change by distance, duration and time of day
items.statement: Explain each week's fare per trip change by distance, duration and time of day. A fare drop from shorter trips needs a different response than one from slower traffic.

items.name: Trip duration prediction
items.statement: Quote each trip's expected duration at pickup and flag the ones likely to run long. Accurate arrival times cut complaints and cancellations.

items.name: Fare levels by zone and hour
items.statement: Set the fare adjustment per zone and hour within the allowed range. Fares matched to demand fill idle hours and ration peak hours.

items.name: Trip segments by distance, fare and time
items.statement: Pick the trip segments for each service offer such as airport or short hops. Offers built per trip segment fit the riders who take them.
